headline: Texas Track & Field · Steeplechase & Cross Country

school.name: The University of Texas at Austin

bio.short: Aishling Callanan is a senior distance runner for Texas: a 10:19.23 steeplechaser who moved to No. 3 on the Longhorns' all-time list in 2025, a cross country leader and a Marketing major. In 2026 she was a Project Manager Intern at Feniex Industries.
long: Aishling Callanan is a fourth-year Longhorn who races everything from 800 meters to 6K cross country, and the steeplechase is where she shines. She finished third in her first-ever steeplechase at the 2025 Texas Relays. A month later she won the event on her home track at the Texas Invitational in 10:19.23, a mark that ranks No. 3 on Texas' all-time performers list. As a senior in 2026 she won the season-opening Floyd Farms Invitational and led the Texas women at the Chile Pepper Festival with a 5K best of 17:00.1.

Callanan grew up in Rancho Palos Verdes, California, and ran for Palos Verdes Peninsula High School. There she set school records in the 800m and 1,600m, broke the all-time record on the hilly Palos Verdes cross country course and placed third in Division II at the 2021 CIF State Championships. At Texas she studies Marketing and has twice made the SEC Academic Honor Roll. As a senior she has taken on mentoring the team's youngest runners, describing her role as "being someone they can look up to."

The steeplechase asks a runner to hold her pace while clearing barriers lap after lap, and Callanan approaches work the same way. As a Project Manager Intern at Feniex Industries in 2026, she helped keep projects on track at the Austin manufacturer of emergency-vehicle lighting: following schedules and status across teams, documenting processes and using her Marketing training to communicate clearly with sales and product colleagues. She brings consistency, composure and a team-first outlook that measures success by how everyone improves.
